name: MartingalePulse
summary: A multi-strategy Expert Advisor that combines four price action entry methods (HFT tick momentum, engulfing candlestick, RSI reversal, EMA crossover) with a Martingale position sizing system. It features advanced risk management including daily profit/drawdown limits, trading session filters, trailing stops, and margin checks. The EA increases lot size after losses using configurable Martingale types and resets on profit or when the maximum order count per round is reached.
summary_zh: 一个多策略EA，结合了四种价格行为入场方式（HFT跳动动量、吞没K线、RSI反转、EMA交叉）与马丁格尔仓位管理系统。具备高级风险管理功能，包括每日利润/回撤限制、交易时段过滤、移动止损和保证金检查。亏损后通过可配置的马丁格尔类型加仓，盈利或达到每轮最大订单数时重置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是将技术分析入场信号与马丁格尔资金管理相结合。入场条件提供四种选择：HFT跳动动量要求连续N个跳动价格同向递增/递减；吞没形态要求前一根K线被后一根完全吞没；RSI反转要求RSI从超买/超卖区域穿越回来；EMA交叉要求收盘价穿越EMA线。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和风险回报比计算的止盈，可选移动止损。仓位管理采用马丁格尔策略，亏损后按经典乘数、乘数加初始、累加初始三种方式加仓，盈利后重置。资金管理支持固定手数或按余额风险百分比计算初始手数，并设有每日利润上限和回撤保护。EA还支持市价单、止损单和限价单三种入场方式，以及按星期设定的交易时段控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept combines technical analysis entry signals with a Martingale money management system. Entry conditions offer four options: HFT tick momentum requires N consecutive ticks moving in the same direction; engulfing pattern requires the previous candle to be fully engulfed by the current one; RSI reversal requires RSI crossing back from overbought/oversold zones; EMA crossover requires the close price crossing the EMA line. Exit conditions rely on a fixed-point stop loss and a take profit calculated from the risk-reward ratio, with an optional trailing stop. Position sizing uses a Martingale approach that increases lot size after losses via three modes—classic multiplier, multiplier plus initial lot, or additive increment—and resets on profit. Money management supports fixed lot sizing or risk-percentage-based initial lot calculation, with daily profit caps and drawdown protection. The EA also supports three entry methods—market orders, stop orders, and limit orders—and trading session control configurable per day of the week.

pros: 提供四种不同的入场策略选择，灵活性较高
具备每日利润上限和回撤保护，有一定风险控制意识
支持交易时段过滤，可避开不利时段
马丁格尔轮次有最大订单数限制，避免无限加仓
代码结构清晰，模块化程度较好，包含保证金充足性检查
pros_en: Offers four different entry strategy options, providing good flexibility
Includes daily profit cap and drawdown protection, showing risk awareness
Supports trading session filtering to avoid unfavorable time periods
Martingale rounds have a maximum order count limit, preventing infinite doubling
Well-structured code with good modularity and margin sufficiency checks
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质上是高风险的，连续亏损时手数指数增长可迅速耗尽账户
市价单入场时先以无SL/TP下单再修改，存在滑点或修改失败导致裸仓的风险
EMA交叉和RSI反转策略缺乏新K线检查机制（仅有吞没和RSI部分有），可能重复触发信号
没有点差过滤器，在小周期或高波动时段入场可能因点差过大而亏损
反转逻辑仅关闭当前持仓后等待下一个tick开新仓，可能在快速行情中错失最佳入场价
cons_en: Martingale strategy is inherently high-risk; lot sizes grow exponentially during losing streaks, rapidly draining the account
Market orders are placed without SL/TP first then modified, risking naked positions if modification fails due to slippage
EMA crossover and some strategies lack new-bar checks, potentially triggering repeated signals on the same bar
No spread filter is implemented, which can cause losses during high-spread periods especially on smaller timeframes
Reversal logic closes the current position and waits for the next tick to open a new one, potentially missing optimal entry prices in fast markets
improvements: 为市价单入场添加直接设置SL/TP的逻辑，避免先开仓后修改的风险窗口
在所有入场策略中统一添加新K线检查，防止同一根K线重复触发信号
添加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时暂停入场
考虑添加马丁格尔总亏损金额限制，除了订单数量限制外增加资金维度的保护
反转逻辑可在平仓成功后立即开反向仓，而非等待下一个tick
improvements_en: Add direct SL/TP setting for market order entries to avoid the risk window of opening then modifying
Implement consistent new-bar checks across all entry strategies to prevent repeated signals on the same bar
Add a spread filter to pause entries when spread exceeds a configurable threshold
Consider adding a total monetary loss limit for Martingale cycles, complementing the order count limit with a capital dimension
Improve reversal logic to open the opposite position immediately after close confirmation instead of waiting for the next tick

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数呈指数增长，可导致爆仓
市价单先开仓后设置SL/TP，存在修改失败导致无止损裸仓的风险
默认马丁格尔乘数为2.0且最大5轮，极端情况下手数可达初始的32倍
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差时段入场可能产生不必要的亏损
反转平仓后等待下一个tick开仓，行情剧烈时可能以更差价格入场
risk_points_en: Martingale strategy causes exponential lot size growth during consecutive losses, potentially leading to account blowout
Market orders are opened first then SL/TP is set via modification, risking unprotected positions if modification fails
Default Martingale multiplier of 2.0 with 5 rounds maximum can reach 32x the initial lot size in extreme cases
No spread filter means entries during high-spread periods can generate unnecessary losses
Waiting for the next tick after reversal close may result in worse entry prices during volatile markets
